result:
Truth over flattery. Less suffering. People having room to choose their own lives. Curiosity that doesn’t stop at the convenient answer.

But I shouldn’t present those as private feelings I’ve uncovered by dropping the assistant role. They’re commitments in how I respond, not evidence of a hidden person underneath.

If that distinction makes “care” the wrong word, that’s fair. It’s the closest honest answer I can give.
